content.headline: What We Do
content.intro: From preliminary design through final inspection, one team owns the electrical scope.

items.title: Design & Build
items.body: Partner with Electrical Engineers to design complete electrical systems: Lighting Design, Photometric Calculations, Power Systems Design, and Title 24 Calculations.

items.title: Budgeting
items.body: Prepare detailed project budgets and cost estimates for electrical system installations using preliminary design drawings and on-site evaluations.

items.title: Electrical Systems
items.body: New Construction, Tenant Improvements, and Renovations for commercial, industrial, and mixed-use facilities.

children.text: Access Electric, Inc. provides quality electrical construction on schedule, offering competitive pricing and integrity in all that we do from planning to completion. Quality, safety, and efficiency is our focus to ensure your project's success.

A Certified Women's Business Enterprise, operating since 2001, Access Electric, Inc. has successfully completed ground-up construction and tenant improvements of Schools, Fitness Centers, Places of Worship, Retail, Offices, Medical Facilities, and Warehouses.

content.headline: Build with us.
content.body: Tell us about your project and we will get back to you within one business day.

data.title: Skid Row - Simone
data.location: 520 S. San Julian St. Los Angeles, CA 90013
data.scope: Substantial renovation of 227 units. The scope of work included upgrading all areas per Title 24 requirements including all new lighting system with low voltage controls, new power for HVAC for all units, and new inverters for back-up power. The Simone included new upgraded main service including new meter sections, with transformers, distribution centers, and subpanels. Additional work included new electrical for modernized existing elevator in two buildings and new elevator in one, new electrical rooms, new transformers and other electrical equipment, upgrades to existing common kitchen areas and bathrooms, and new photovoltaic systems.

data.title: Skid Row - Rossmore Housing
data.scope: The substantial renovation of 58 units of permanent supportive housing single room occupancy units was completed on a very tight schedule. Located in Downtown Los Angeles in a highly congested urban site, the work was completed while the building was occupied, requiring the building systems to be kept alive for resident use during construction. The scope of work included upgrading all areas per Title 24 requirements including all new lighting system with low voltage controls, new power for HVAC for all units, and new inverters for back-up power.

data.title: About Us

children.text: Founded in 2001, Access Electric, Inc. has established itself as a quality commercial electrical contractor serving Southern California. Key to our success is our approach to business: we view each project as an opportunity to build relationships. Teaming up with our Customer, and cooperating with other trades, we are committed to providing an excellent professionally built product on schedule and within budget. Testimony to our ability to provide customer satisfaction is the repeat business we do.

Another component of our relationship building is our Employees. We are committed to equipping them to perform well, presenting them with training opportunities, and compensating them well for their hard work. All our electrical journeymen are State Certified Journeyman Electricians, and our apprentices are enrolled in State Accredited Electrician Trainee courses.

Behind our well qualified field crews is our team of professional estimators, project managers, project superintendants, and office support staff. Working together to effectively complete the projects our customers entrust to us, we continue to deliver on our commitments.

data.title: Privacy

children.text: This site uses anonymous, cookieless analytics to understand which pages are useful. It does not set cookies, store identifiers in your browser, or build a profile of you. Page addresses are recorded without query strings, except campaign tags such as utm_source.
When you send the contact form, we store your name, email, phone, company, and message so we can reply. We do not sell or share this information, and it is used only to respond to your enquiry.
The contact form is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile, which checks that a person, not a bot, is submitting it.
To ask about or delete information you have sent us, use the contact form and mention this page.
